violation_type.title: Background Checks Kept Confidential (26 TAC §746.201(6))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the course of the investigation, it has been determined that the background check and personal confidential information was disclosed to unauthorized persons.  The operation no longer was authorized to use this information after the individual left employment.  The background check information was accessed without the individual's consent and was processed by the operation three times after employment ended.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained during the course of the investigation, it has been determined that the background check and personal confidential information was disclosed to unauthorized persons. Back ground check was missing from 4 out of 4 staff files.    NOTE: Director printed out the background checks for 4 out of the 4 missing employee background forms.
The operation used email marieliza@charter.net associated with the operation to receive Confidential background check information.
